Carry from SBC screen_start_address_low reaches the second SBC (LDA abs,X and STA abs,Y leave C). wa_off + 1 (&4A) is written only by the dropped store and read nowhere in src/ or tools/ (late code uses X). record_live is reached only by the two JMPs in put_on (render.6502 1332, 1396), each right after LDY dm_index; dm_index (&67, ren_zp) is written only at 1321 and not by sky_put_on, world_of_address or late_column, so LDY dm_index restores the same Y as PLY; exit A/X/C/V as before, N/Z overwritten by the following LDA. list_live (1167) uses the unchanged entry. Room: bank 4 grows 4 bytes; ends after the change: shipping B381, gameplay B3C8, DEBUG_FULLREDRAW B3FD, SKY_HELI=0 B3FB, all under REN_BASE &B400 (fullredraw has 3 bytes left). The shift256end and gameplay+DEBUG_FULLREDRAW / gameplay+SKY_HELI=0 builds fail identically without the change (bank 5 overrun etc.), so not caused by it.
